# Test fixtures

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `ball_in_flight.png` | Crop (no people) of `static/img/detection.PNG` from [chonyy/AI-basketball-analysis](https://github.com/chonyy/AI-basketball-analysis) | MIT |
| `basketball1.png` | `samples/data/basketball1.png` from [OpenCV](https://github.com/opencv/opencv) | Apache-2.0 |

`basketball1.png` is grayscale, motion-blurred and the ball is held in a hand: the generic COCO
models do **not** detect it. It is kept as a documented hard case (see README → Known limitations).
